message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest players in NBA history. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School before being selected first overall in the 2003 NBA Draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers. He has also played for the Miami Heat and returned to the Cavaliers before joining the Los Angeles Lakers.

James is known for his versatility, athleticism, and basketball IQ. Over his career, he has won multiple NBA championships (2012, 2013 with the Heat; 2016 with the Cavaliers; 2020 with the Lakers), earned four NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) awards, and been named to numerous All-NBA teams and NBA All-Star games. Off the court, he is involved in various philanthropic efforts, including the LeBron James Family Foundation, and has pursued acting and business ventures.
